record.name: Stripe
record.one_liner: Online payment processing and financial infrastructure platform for internet businesses
record.access_note: Sign up for a Stripe account on the website to obtain test and live API keys instantly in the dashboard.
record.api_note: The REST API covers charges, customers, subscriptions, payment intents, and extensive financial operations.

evidence.quote: The Stripe API is organized around REST.
The Stripe API uses API keys to authenticate requests.
You can view and manage your API keys in the Stripe Dashboard.
The Stripe API is organized around REST.
The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use
You can use the Stripe API in sandboxes without affecting your live data
